items.title: Native Solana test-network acceptance (Block A)
items.blockedReason: Steps 1 to 12 are done: the first player withdrawal, its fee split and the first backer claim ran on 2026-10-31 under the accepted revised timing, with every check passing. Step 13, the withdrawal that ends round one, cannot happen before 2026-11-06 at 02:23 UTC: the game's insolvency rule is first met shortly after midnight that day and the plan keeps a margin of about two hours. Rob asked whether it can come earlier; Silas's assessment, now with Gideon, finds only that margin could be removed for this run, at the cost of a revised operator tool. Step 13 also needs Gideon's go-ahead. No Internet Computer activation or real rewards are part of this work.
items.nextAction: Gideon reviews the step 13 timing assessment. Then, on or after 2026-11-06 at 02:23 UTC and with his go-ahead, run step 13 and the draw steps that follow it in the same sitting.
